FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Price Holds Above MA20 as Intervention Signal Stays Muted
tldr_points: USD/JPY trades above MA20, confirming near-term upside structure.
RSI-14 at 73.42 signals strength but limits chase-entry quality.
Kihara gave no fresh intervention signal, keeping intervention risk contained for now.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY stays above MA20 with overbought RSI; buy pullbacks while intervention risk remains muted.
FX.comment: Price holds above MA20 with supportive macro backdrop, but overbought RSI requires pullback entry discipline.
